Thanks for suggesting a package! Before filing, please check that it isn't
already covered:

- Supported packages: https://pypi.riseproject.dev/python-wheels/packages/
- If a package is listed as "deprecated" it means upstream now ships riscv64
  wheels themselves, so no request is needed.

The more of the fields below you can fill in, the faster a build workflow can be
put together. See the Development Guide for how these map to a build workflow:
https://pypi.riseproject.dev/python-wheels/development.html
-->

<!-- The distribution name as it appears on PyPI, e.g. `numpy`. -->

## Version(s) requested
<!-- Specific release tag(s) you need, e.g. 2.5.2. "Latest" is fine if unsure. -->

## Why is this needed?
<!-- Your use case, and any downstream packages/projects this unblocks. -->

## Additional context
<!-- Known riscv64 build issues, required patches, GPL-linked libraries, or anything else useful. -->
